Plans Revealed For Redevelopment Of 3601 West Cortland Street In Logan Square

View of 3601 W Cortland St via Google Maps

By: Ian Achong 7:45 am on September 9, 2026

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:37
Instaread

Updated plans have been revealed for the residential conversion of the existing building at 3601 West Cortland Street in Logan Square. Located on the corner with North Central Park Avenue, the building previously served as a substance abuse recovery center but has sat vacant in recent years after multiple redevelopment attempts.

Site context map of 3601 W Cortland St via Google Maps

Site plan of 3601 W Cortland St by Baker Barrios

The current plans are being led by the same team behind the last redevelopment attempt, that being Key Development Partners along with architecture firm Baker Barrios. The proposal encompasses the four-story building along with its adjacent surface parking lot, which would be preserved. The U-shaped structure would have its side lightwell filled in for additional unit space.

Floor plans of 3601 W Cortland St by Baker Barrios

The updated lower levels would include a small lobby, amenity space, bike storage room, fitness room, and plenty of tenant storage. The rest of the building will hold 42 residential units made up of studios and one-bedroom layouts, of which six will be affordable. The last floor will also include a new party room/tenant lounge connected to a small outdoor terrace on top of the side expansion.

Elevation of 3601 W Cortland St by Baker Barrios

Rents for the units will range from $1,600 to $2,100 per month, with residents also being able to lease one of the 34 fenced-in parking spaces next door for $150 per month, per Block Club. The plans presented to the community last weekend received minor feedback on parking and traffic. The team will now need alderwoman approval along with that of the Zoning Board of Appeals for variances.
